args.code: (() => { const segs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => /^(Isolate|Compose)$/.test(b.textContent.trim())); const compose = segs.find(b => b.textContent.trim() === 'Compose'); if (!compose) return JSON.stringify({err:'no seg', btns: segs.map(s=>s.textContent)}); compose.click(); const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.lic-row')); if (rows[0]) rows[0].click(); if (rows[3]) rows[3].click(); return JSON.stringify({clicked:'compose + rows 1,4'}); })()
